description:
Working across the street from the World Trade Center, Stefan heard the first plane hit the towers and rushed to help. Debbie had been evacuated from the New York Subway and found herself next to Stefan when she was struck by falling debris. Stefan didn't leave her side, tending to her wounds, as she became the first patient admitted to the hospital on 9/11. 25 years later, they finally reconnect.

description:
